title: BanPact
description: This plugin adds the ban pact from Trim SMP. It adds a book capable of banning players and a ritual for reviving them
body:
Credits for [Yushaa](https://discord.gg/d4y3rp2N8V) for the original skript
## 📖 Overview

**BanPact** is a high-stakes Minecraft plugin that brings real consequences to PvP and survival gameplay. Players can craft a **Ban Pact** book to mark another player for death — if the target dies within **1 hour**, they are **permanently banned** from the server. The only way to bring them back? A dramatic, server-wide **Revival Ritual** that must be defended for 5 full minutes.

This plugin is perfect for **hardcore SMPs**, **Lifesteal servers**, **lore-driven communities**, and any server that wants meaningful, high-tension player interactions.

---

## ⚡ Features

### 🔴 Ban Pact System
- **Craftable Ban Pact Book** — Players craft a powerful book using rare materials (Echo Shards, Netherite Blocks, Recovery Compass) and right-click to select a target from an intuitive GUI.
- **1-Hour Death Timer** — Once a player is "ban pacted," they have 1 hour to survive. If they die or disconnect during this time, they are **instantly banned**.
- **Coordinate Leaks** — The target's coordinates are broadcast to the entire server every 5 minutes, creating a thrilling manhunt.
- **Command Blocking** — Pacted players cannot use teleportation commands (`/home`, `/tpa`, `/warp`, `/team warp`, `/team home`) during the pact, preventing easy escapes.
- **Epic Effects** — Full title screen notifications, totem sound effects, and blindness flash when a pact is activated.
- **Survival Reward** — If the target survives the full hour, the entire server is notified with a victory announcement.

### 🟢 Revival Ritual System
- **Craftable Revive Book** — Players can craft a Revive Book to initiate a revival ritual for any banned player.
- **5-Minute Defense Ritual** — A lectern is placed at the initiator's location with the banned player's head displayed on a rotating armor stand. The ritual must be defended for 5 minutes.
- **Destructible Ritual** — Enemy players can attack the ritual's armor stands to deal damage. If the ritual's health drops to 0%, it fails and the banned player stays banned.
- **Boss Bar & Timer** — A server-wide boss bar tracks the ritual's progress with a color-coded health indicator (green → yellow → red).
- **End Crystal Beam** — A dramatic End Crystal spawns high above the ritual, projecting a beam down to the lectern for a stunning visual effect.
- **Expanding Halo Particles** — Color-coded particle rings pulse outward from the ritual, changing color based on the ritual's remaining health.
- **Server-Wide Announcements** — The ritual's location and dimension are broadcast to all players, inviting attackers or defenders.

### 🎨 Polished GUI System
- **Ban Pact GUI** — Click a player head to select your target. Clean, inventory-based interface.
- **Revive GUI** — Browse all currently banned players and select who to revive.
- **Ban Book List GUI** — View all players currently under an active Ban Pact, including their last known coordinates and world.

---

## 🛠️ Crafting Recipes

### Ban Pact Book
```
[Echo Shard]    [Netherite Block]  [Echo Shard]
[Netherite Block] [Recovery Compass] [Netherite Block]
[Echo Shard]    [Netherite Block]  [Echo Shard]
```
---
## 🎮 How It Works

### Banning a Player
1. Craft or obtain a **Ban Pact** book
2. Right-click the book to open the target selection GUI
3. Click on a player's head to activate the pact
4. The target has **1 hour** to survive — their coords are leaked every 5 minutes
5. If they **die or disconnect**, they are permanently banned
6. If they **survive**, the pact ends and they are celebrated

### Reviving a Banned Player
1. Craft or obtain a **Revive Book**
2. Right-click the book to see all banned players
3. Select a player to start the **Revival Ritual**
4. A ritual site spawns at your location with visual effects
5. **Defend the ritual for 5 minutes** — enemies can attack it to reduce its health
6. If the ritual survives, the player is **unbanned and revived**
7. If the ritual is destroyed, the player **stays banned**
